title: Concept: SQL built by concatenation (scala) — review required
description: In scala, SQLs*((?:[^()]|([^()]*))*(?:+|${) mixes code and data in one SQL string. Concatenation is the classic injection primitive: quotes and keywords in the input rewrite the statement. The remedy is bound parameters via SQL with .on() bindings.
applicability: scala codebases issuing SQL through the flagged call; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise (read, write, execute) when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
